item.text:
Implemented the notification toggle. The page reads the preference from an HTTP-only cookie, and the Server Action flips it and calls `refresh()` from `next/cache` to update the current page without redirecting.

- [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:1)
- [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1)

The starter has no user or database layer, so the preference is stored per browser. I left the existing `package.json` change and untracked `package-lock.json` untouched. I did not run tests.
